mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS pond_id, p.pond_name, b.base_name, p.status AS pond_status, d.metric_key, d.metric_value, DATE_FORMAT(d.record_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS record_time FROM pond_info p LEFT JOIN base_info b ON p.base_id = b.id LEFT JOIN iot_device dev ON dev.pond_id = p.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT device_id, metric_key, MAX(record_time) AS max_time FROM iot_ts_data WHERE metric_key IN ('dissolved_oxygen', 'temperature', 'ph') GROUP BY device_id, metric_key ) latest ON latest.device_id = dev.id INNER JOIN iot_ts_data d ON d.device_id = latest.device_id AND d.metric_key = latest.metric_key AND d.record_time = latest.max_time WHERE p.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY p.id, d.metric_key

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.record_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS record_time, d.metric_key, d.metric_value FROM iot_ts_data d INNER JOIN iot_device dev ON d.device_id = dev.id WHERE dev.pond_id = #{pondId} AND d.metric_key IN ('dissolved_oxygen', 'temperature', 'ph') AND d.record_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ORDER BY d.record_time ASC
